description: This Java source file defines a conditional configuration class 'KafkaRemoteJobTopicAutoCreateCondition' that extends Spring Boot's 'AllNestedConditions'. It combines three conditional annotations that activate only when specific properties are set to 'true' in the application's configuration, enabling conditional bean creation based on these property values related to Kafka and batch manager features.
